using System.Diagnostics;

if (args.Contains("--version", StringComparer.Ordinal))
{
    Console.WriteLine("Godot Engine v4.6.3.stable.mono");
    return;
}

var pwsh = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("FAKE_HARNESS_PWSH") ?? "pwsh";
var fixture = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("FAKE_HARNESS_FIXTURE");
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fixture))
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine("FAKE_HARNESS_FIXTURE is required");
    Environment.ExitCode = 2;
    return;
}

var child = new Process
{
    StartInfo = new ProcessStartInfo
    {
        FileName = pwsh,
        UseShellExecute = false,
        RedirectStandardOutput = false,
        RedirectStandardError = false,
        CreateNoWindow = true,
    },
};
child.StartInfo.ArgumentList.Add("-NoProfile");
child.StartInfo.ArgumentList.Add("-NonInteractive");
child.StartInfo.ArgumentList.Add("-File");
child.StartInfo.ArgumentList.Add(fixture);
string? projectPath = null;
string? state = null;
string? runId = null;
for (var i = 0; i < args.Length; i++)
{
    if (args[i] == "--path" && i + 1 < args.Length) projectPath = args[i + 1];
    if (args[i].StartsWith("--state=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) state = args[i][8..];
    if (args[i].StartsWith("--run-id=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) runId = args[i][9..];
}
if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(projectPath) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(state) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(runId))
{
    var scenarioRoot = Path.Combine(projectPath, "artifacts", "harness", runId, "scenarios", state);
    Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("FAKE_HARNESS_OUTPUT", Path.Combine(scenarioRoot, state + ".png"));
    Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("FAKE_HARNESS_RESULT", Path.Combine(scenarioRoot, "result.json"));
}
foreach (var arg in args)
{
    // PowerShell -File can truncate an --option=C:\path token on Windows.
    // Preserve those paths through the environment while forwarding the
    // original arguments for the rest of the fixture protocol.
    if (arg.StartsWith("--output=", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("FAKE_HARNESS_OUTPUT", arg[9..]);
    if (arg.StartsWith("--result=", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("FAKE_HARNESS_RESULT", arg[9..]);
    child.StartInfo.ArgumentList.Add(arg);
}
child.Start();
child.WaitForExit();
Environment.ExitCode = child.ExitCode;
